newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto exchange says modifies Bre-X trading rules.
newsitem.headline: Toronto exchange says modifies Bre-X trading rules.

text.p: The Toronto Stock Exchange, Canada's biggest equities market, said on Friday that modified trading rules will apply to shares of Bre-X Minerals Ltd ahead of a key report on its Busang gold find expected on Monday.
The TSE said in a statement the modified rules were necessary "in anticipation of what could be an unprecedented number of orders following release of the...interim report."
Strathcona Mineral Services Ltd, hired in March to conduct an audit of the controversial Busang project, was expected to deliver an interim report to Bre-X as early as today.
Bre-X has said it will issue a press release before North American financial markets open on Monday.
